name: To8Slider Lite
author: To8gal

sections.description:
ProSlider Lite is a simple and lightweight image/video slider plugin for WordPress.

Features:

  • Create sliders with images and videos.
  • Custom transition effects: fade, slide, slide up, zoom.
  • Autoplay and speed options.
  • Display sliders anywhere using [proslider id="123"] shortcode.
  • Lite version includes basic functionality; advanced features available in Pro version.

Pro version adds:

  • Title, description, and CTA for each slide.
  • Show/hide controls.
  • Extended autoplay options.

Arbitrary section

Lite version of ProSlider. For full features, please see the Pro version.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/proslider-lite directory, or install via WordPress plugin installer.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Add a new slider via the “Sliders” custom post type.
  4. Insert the slider anywhere using the shortcode [proslider id="123"].
sections.faq:
How do I add a slider to a page or post?

Use the shortcode [proslider id="123"] where 123 is the slider post ID.

Can I use videos in the free version?

Yes, the Lite version supports videos, but advanced options are available in Pro.

How do I upgrade to Pro?

Click the “Buy Pro” button in the slider settings or visit: https://gumroad.com/l/YOUR_PRODUCT_ID
